items.title: Bind delivery-check artifacts to reviewed material
items.context: delivery_check_set records the current materialHash/headHash in delivery-check.json and includes the material binding in the integrity hash; missing or tampered bindings fail closed instead of silently passing.
items.userSees: "delivery-check-freshness smoke passed" and delivery-check.json records materialHash for the reviewed material.
excludes: Do not change delivery reviewer role ownership or allow the main agent to self-sign delivery-check evidence.
Do not treat local evidence as Authority or production proof.

happy.desc: A fresh delivery-check written over the current material remains accepted by DONE readiness.

edge.desc: A metadata-only head change with unchanged material does not force a delivery reviewer rerun.

adversarial.desc: A delivery-check with missing or tampered material binding is rejected as stale/tampered, not accepted as delivery_check_passed.

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke asserts a fresh delivery_check_set record with current materialHash is accepted by DONE oracle, machine guard, and lifecycle readiness.
Smoke asserts metadata-only HEAD drift after delivery-check does not stale the delivery check when materialHash is unchanged.
Smoke asserts missing materialHash binding and tampered materialHash binding fail closed instead of passing delivery_check_passed.

items.title: Fail closed when material changes after delivery-check
items.context: DONE oracle, machine guard, and lifecycle readiness classify material drift after delivery-check as stale_delivery_check and block DONE until lattice-review-delivery reruns.
items.userSees: DONE pre-check prints "delivery-check: stale" / "stale_delivery_check" after source material changes post-delivery-check.
excludes: Do not weaken validation, review, summary, or done_prepare gates.
Do not add a dashboard or external server dependency.

happy.desc: After source material changes, DONE readiness reports stale delivery-check and blocks DONE.

edge.desc: Existing docsPromise validation semantics still fail unverified promises independently of material freshness.

adversarial.desc: Changing delivery-check binding fields without resigning produces a hash/tamper failure.

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke changes material after delivery-check and verifies DONE oracle, machine guard, and lifecycle readiness block with stale_delivery_check.
Smoke keeps material fresh while using an unverified docsPromise and verifies docs_promise_unresolved behavior remains independent.
Smoke mutates the signed materialHash field without resigning and verifies delivery-check _hash tamper failure.

items.title: Add focused regression smoke and baseline result artifact
items.context: Add a focused smoke for delivery-check freshness and a derived baseline item 5 result JSON without modifying the immutable baseline v1 file.
items.userSees: `lattice validate --focus=fast --json` includes delivery-check-freshness-smoke and the smoke prints "delivery-check-freshness smoke passed".
excludes: Do not edit the immutable baseline v1 artifact.
Do not broaden this into DONE summary freshness; that remains baseline item 6.

happy.desc: Focused smoke passes and is wired into validate.commands with fast focus.

edge.desc: The immutable baseline v1 file remains unchanged; only a story-specific result artifact is added.

adversarial.desc: The result artifact explicitly states authorityChanged=false, receiptVerified=false, and productionDone=false.

verificationEvidence.note: Fast validation includes node packages/main/dist/tasks/delivery-check-freshness-smoke.js and the smoke prints delivery-check-freshness smoke passed.
Story-specific result artifact was added; immutable baseline v1 artifact was not modified.
Result artifact explicitly records authorityChanged=false, receiptVerified=false, and productionDone=false.

items.title: Verify process-fact registry and artifact contract coverage for delivery-check binding
items.context: Because this story changes gate-consumed delivery-check evidence, PLAN/DEV must either update the process-fact registry/artifact contract to describe the new material binding or prove the existing delivery-check contract already covers it; focused tests must include the contract path.
items.userSees: `node scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs` passes and the smoke asserts delivery-check.json remains L4 gate evidence produced by delivery_check_set.
excludes: Do not add unrelated process-fact registry entries.
Do not weaken artifact or gate-evidence levels.

happy.desc: Process-fact/artifact contract validation passes after delivery-check material binding changes.

edge.desc: The delivery-check artifact remains L4 gate evidence and delivery_check_set remains the producer command.

adversarial.desc: The implementation cannot silently add a gate-consumed delivery-check field without either contract coverage or an explicit proof that existing coverage applies.

verificationEvidence.note: Process-fact contract verification passes after delivery-check material binding changes.
Smoke asserts delivery-check.json remains L4 signed gate evidence produced by delivery_check_set and owned by lattice-review-delivery.
Smoke plus process-fact verification prove the new gate-consumed material binding is covered by the existing signed delivery-check artifact contract.
